title: Bastien-Lepage's Portrait of His Grandfather
content: Jules Bastien-Lepage, Portrait of my Grandfather, 1874Jules Bastien-Lepage(1848-1884) was one of the founders of Naturalism. A critic in 1883 said, "The whole world paints so much today like M. Bastien-Lepage that M. Bastien-Lepage seems to paint like the whole world."Roger Fry said that the public acceptance of Impressionism owed much to the pioneering work of M. Bastien-Lepage. Monet's popularity, he said, "required the teaching of men like Bastien-Lepage, who cleverly compromised between the truth and an accepted convention of what things looked like, to bring the world gradually around to admitting truths which a single walk in the country with purely unbiased vision would have established beyond doubt."-----Jules Bastien-Lepageon WikipediaBook:Jules Bastien-Lepage
